productIntent.rule: Repository product intent is non-diagnostic cosmetic skin-care guidance. Regulatory medical-device classification remains external authority and is not asserted by repository implementation alone.

googlePlay.healthFeatureBasis: Google Play's Health apps declaration guidance explicitly includes skin care under Diseases and Conditions Management.

apple.rule: Do not present BEJEWELY output as a validated health measurement, diagnosis, treatment, or medical decision. Cosmetic visible observations and skin-care personalization must remain explicitly non-medical.

allowed: cosmetic product recommendation explanations grounded in survey and visible cues
non-diagnostic language such as visible redness, surface shine, dry-looking texture, and breakout-prone concerns
forbidden: diagnosing or asserting a disease, disorder, infection, allergy, or medical condition
claiming to treat, cure, or prevent a medical condition
claiming validated health-measurement accuracy without externally verified evidence
turning visible image cues into medical severity or pathology conclusions
